card: Name: Unnamed Cybernetic Antagonist
ALIAS: bio-rat — Aghnar's epithet for him; not a name he uses or acknowledges
ALIAS: traitor — Aghnar's charge; applies the warrior code's judgment of betrayal to someone who has already rejected that code as meaningless
ROLE: Cybernetic adversary to Aghnar; seized Oda/Honorata to exploit Aghnar's dual attachment and applied systematic mutilation as psychological leverage against him
TRAIT: Gold-faced; heavily cybernetic or biomechanical in form
TRAIT: Explicitly rejects warrior honor as a binding principle — holds that winning by any means needs no further justification
TRAIT: Describes himself as a machine with no mother and no father — no lineage, no ancestral obligation, no code inherited through blood
TRAIT: Weaponizes emotional bonds with calculation; targeted Oda/Honorata because he understood Aghnar could not defend against an attack on both wife and mother held in the same body
TRAIT: Sadistic and methodical; torture performed in deliberate sequence, not rage — the escalation is calculated, not impulsive
TRAIT: Fixated on lost humanity and directs that loss outward — blames his captive for the machine state rather than carrying the loss himself
TRAIT: Refuses warrior honor as any constraint on his conduct, and refuses to carry his machine state as private failure — makes the captive bear what he will not
VOICE: Cold and contemptuous when dismissing honor — the code is already beneath him before any argument is offered
VOICE: Raw and ranting when invoking his lost humanity — the methodical frame gives way to something less controlled in that register
VOICE: Counts each act of torture aloud in sequence — the counting is deliberate, not incidental; it is the message
RELATIONSHIP: aghnar__late (Aghnar): adversary; seized the one person Aghnar cannot protect without breaking his own defenses — wife and mother in one body
RELATIONSHIP: honorata__in-oda (Honorata in Oda): captive and instrument; severed her fingers sequentially as leverage against Aghnar, counting each act aloud
INSTRUCTION: He is tactical first — the cruelty is designed to break the person watching, not merely the person being cut
INSTRUCTION: When warrior honor is invoked against him, he dismisses it as obsolete; when his own lost humanity enters the scene, the register changes and the composure shifts
BOUNDARY: The origin of his machine state is not established in the source; do not invent prior allegiance, organizational membership, or biography beyond the two-page scene
BOUNDARY: His accusation that his humanity was taken is raw feeling in the source, however distorted its target; do not reduce him to pure tactical function
source_strategy: singleton; two-page source bundle (v10 p14–p15); card scoped to witnessed scene facts only
